title: Deeva Baleya Na Phul Paaey Eh
body:
Deeva baleya na phul paaey eh qabar kedi eh rahwaan vich
Ik masooma si mar gaey eh qaidi veeran diaan baavaan vich
Abid nal lipat ke rondi si keevain vakhri qaid nibhaavaangi
Chad ke kaleya menu jaaveen na chan veeran mein mar jaavaangi
Sun ke gallaan zindaan rovay jo hoyaan bhen bhiraavaan vich
Mere dardaan da ehsaas kareen keevain babay nu mein bhul jaavaan
Takh zaalim mojza ujri da shabbir di dhi mein dikhlaavaan
Mera peu naizay te ro paya eh eh assar he meriaan haavaan vich
Lakh zulm karay eh shimr laeen mein rona eh mein rovaangi
Babay di qabar te jaavaangi jadon veer azaad mein hovaangi
Abid ton puchdi takh urde panchi azad havaavaan vich
Shabbir di jaaee de gham vich jera do athroon vi vahaaega
Dukh yaad karay ga ujri day jera taboot uthaaey ga
Onu sain Sakina mahshar tak rakhay gi yaad duaavaan vich
Keevain hoee maut Sakina di Zainab ne keya sajjad dasa
Abid ne keya ki haal dasaan jadoon mein masooma kol gaya
Babay da naa si us vaylay ujri day akhri saavaan vich
Sajjad oh jhinkaan jhaldi raee baghee di dhi sab kenday san
Jadoon yasrab de vich vasday san sab haashmi naz uthainday san
Ik shahzadi si par rul gaey oh karbal de sehraavaan vich
